name: Metalwork
author: Lyle Mills
description: Paired inharmonic modes turn one struck-metal model into anvil, agogo, plate, and gong families with controllable beating.

controls.label: Object
controls.description: Selects anvil, agogo, plate, or gong mode ratios on the next strike.

controls.label: Hardness
controls.description: Trades a soft low mallet response for a hard upper-mode strike.

controls.label: Damping
controls.description: Opens the object from a dry knock to a long metal ring.

controls.label: Beating
controls.description: Detunes a paired copy of every mode from stable metal to slow shimmering interference.

outputs.main: Mono: the complete struck object. Stereo: the left modal pickup.
outputs.aux: Mono: upper modes and dry metal strike. Stereo: the right modal pickup.

trigger: Strikes the object and samples the current Object selection for that hit.
